prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1348; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a busy road in Sugar Land, Texas, when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle. The impact was hard enough to push me forward against my seatbelt, and I felt an immediate stiffness in my neck and upper back. I stayed at the scene until the other driver and I exchanged details, and I have described what happened the same way every time I have spoken about it, whether with the other driver, the responding officer, or my insurer. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating my own vehicle with permission from no one else. I went to a clinic the same day because the pain grew worse overnight, and I have been following the treatment plan I was given. I am providing this account so the claim can be assessed based on what I experienced.
